text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~♪ It's finally here... The 
croquette bargain sale day is――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much! Well then, I'll be 
on my way!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Ines-san. Just finishing up your 
part-time job?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm off the clock, or rather, I'm thinking 
of getting some running in before my next 
shift!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta make sure not to waste the time 
between my shifts! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah. No, no, it's nothing! Just thinking to 
myself, 'Ah, youth~'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It's amazing, isn't it? Being able to 
run toward your dreams with all your 
might.
choice_data_list: Let's put everything into resting too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Uh-oh, did you get fired up too, 
Trainer? Ah, to be young~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I don't mind keeping you company. 
Nature-san is the type who has a strong 
sense of duty, after all—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I was just in the mood for that anyway.

Afterward, I did some extra training 
together with Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Resting... with all your might...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Ahahaha! In that case, we need 
to put our all into resting.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll add a vegetable croquette today 
too~

I ate croquettes together with Nice 
Nature, recharging our energy.
